name: Core-Keeper-Dedicated-Server
description: Docker file for the new Core Keeper dedicated server running from SteamCMD. (No account etc needed) If your files do not load please check https://github.com/escapingnetwork/core-keeper-dedicated/issues/5

paths.name: Server files
paths.description: Path to server files, not required

variables.name: WORLD_NAME
variables.description: The name you wish to give to your server and its associated world

variables.name: MAX_PLAYERS
variables.description: Maximum number of players that will be allowed to connect to server.

variables.name: GAME_ID
variables.description: Game ID to use for the server. Need to be at least 23 characters and alphanumeric, excluding Y,y,x,0,O. Empty or not valid means a new ID will be generated at start.

variables.name: DATA_PATH
variables.description: Save file location. If not set it defaults to a sub-folder named

labels.name: WORLD_SEED
labels.description: The seed to use for a new world. Set to 0 to generate random seed.
